title: One Bite Here And You STAY 🍑
description:
Everyone warns you about my aunt's valley. Never eat one of her peaches, or every road out leads back to her gate.

I've visited twelve summers and never had a bite. And every summer, the drive there gets a little longer.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment PEACH if you'd take the bite.
